title: Non-public scanner hit in git history (generic-api-key) on .planning/intel/.last-refresh.json: the flagged 64-hex value is the SHA-256 content hash of .planning/intel/api-map.json at the same commit, not a credential (read-only diagnosis; classification awaits the operator at ESC-SECRET-02)

evidence.note: history-scan.json hits index 4: generic-api-key, .planning/intel/.last-refresh.json:4:6@b6156507b887402199d147957162ac253821eff9, classification non-public (reported by all three passes)

evidence.ref: node <scratch>/verify-hyp.js <history-scan.json> <repo> (read-only: git show <commit>:<file>, compares SHA-256 digests in memory, prints booleans only)
evidence.note: key_looks_like_filename true; the value is a member of the file's "hashes" map (top-level keys hashes, timestamp, version); value_equals_sha256_of_referenced_file true (.planning/intel/api-map.json at the same commit); all 5 of 5 64-hex values in that map equal the SHA-256 of the file they name; the file is the GSD intel refresh stamp, still tracked at HEAD

evidence.ref: node <scratch>/mask-view.js <history-scan.json> <repo> (prints the hit line with every 6+ character token replaced by its length, character class and entropy)
evidence.note: line shape: "<name>.json": "<len=64,hex,H=3.90>", the previous line has the same shape

sibling_sites_checked: All 4 non-public history hits were diagnosed the same way (this one and the three in AUD-SECRET-005). The other four 64-hex values in the same hashes map are not flagged only because their keys differ; all five are file content hashes. No other .planning/intel file has a hit.
severity_rationale: S4/none on the read-only diagnosis: a SHA-256 digest of a tracked, public planning file grants access to nothing. Kept as a candidate with secret_class non-public because the scanner classification is mechanical (all three passes reported it) and only the operator re-labels a non-public hit (D-16 immediate tier, precedent ESC-SECRET-01). If the operator rules it a real secret it is re-graded (S1 EXPOSURE) and rotation becomes a proposed card.
recommendation: Operator decides at ESC-SECRET-02. Auditor recommendation: record it as a scanner false positive (a file content hash), no rotation, no history rewrite. Phase 22 changes nothing.
